questions.question: Which of the following is a west-flowing peninsular river that forms an estuary instead of a delta?
questions.explanation: Narmada flows through a rift valley westward into the Arabian Sea and forms an estuary, not a delta. All east-flowing rivers (Godavari, Krishna, Cauvery) form deltas.

questions.question: The Brahmaputra river is known by which name in Tibet?
questions.explanation: Brahmaputra is called Tsangpo in Tibet, Dihang in Arunachal Pradesh, and Brahmaputra in Assam.

questions.question: Which doab lies between the Beas and Sutlej rivers?
questions.explanation: Bist Doab lies between Beas and Sutlej. Bari = Beas-Ravi. Rechna = Ravi-Chenab. Chaj = Chenab-Jhelum.

questions.question: How many states fall in the catchment area of the Godavari river?
questions.explanation: Godavari basin covers 7 states: Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, and Odisha.

questions.question: The Luni river, originating from the Pushkar Valley, ends in which of the following?
questions.explanation: Luni is India's only major river with inland drainage — it ends in the Rann of Kutch without reaching any sea.
